name: USB Adapter

steps.text: Make sure at least one Access Point 2443 or other dual-band Insteon product is installed; the USB Adapter is RF-only.
Make sure the USB Adapter is not connected to your computer.
Download the FTDI virtual COM port (VCP) driver for your operating system, then save, extract and run it.
Plug the USB Adapter into an available USB port on your computer.
steps.expect: Status LED turns on solid green and stays on while plugged in

steps.text: Start your Insteon-compatible software and follow its instructions to add and use the USB Adapter.

verification.note: Read from the Portable USB Adapter 2448A7 Quick Start Guide, from 2010 and for Windows only, and the USB Stick 2448A7 Quick Start Guide, from 2013 and for PC or Mac: two versions for the same model that give the same steps apart from the operating systems; no document names the 2448A7H.

steps.text: Have the controlling software send the Start ALL-Linking command to the USB Adapter.

notes: The 2448A7 has no SET button, so linking mode must be started from software.

verification.note: Read from the USB Adapter Developer Notes; no document names the 2448A7H.

sources: Portable USB Adapter 2448A7 Quick Start Guide
